mapper.select: SELECT p.id projectId,p.project_code projectCode,p.project_name projectName,p.dept_id deptId,p.dept_name_snapshot deptName, p.owner_user_id leaderUserId,p.owner_name_snapshot leaderRealName,p.project_type projectType,p.project_level projectLevel,p.business_status lifecycleStage FROM project p WHERE p.lifecycle_status='ACTIVE' AND ( #{global}=TRUE OR p.owner_user_id=#{userId} OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM project_member m WHERE m.project_id=p.id AND m.user_id=#{userId}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM project_access_grant g WHERE g.project_id=p.id AND g.grantee_user_id=#{userId} AND g.status='ACTIVE' AND (g.effective_from IS NULL OR g.effective_from<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) AND (g.effective_to IS NULL OR g.effective_to>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) AND (g.grant_role_code='PROJECT_PROXY_RECORDER_ASSIGNMENT' OR (#{expert}=TRUE AND g.grant_role_code='PROJECT_MODULE_EXPERT_ASSIGNMENT') OR (#{finance}=TRUE AND g.grant_role_code='PROJECT_FINANCE_HANDLER_ASSIGNMENT'))) OR (#{department}=TRUE AND p.dept_id=#{deptId,jdbcType=BIGINT})) ORDER BY p.id DESC
